say_intro: 기록상 제일 무거운 코끼리는 10.9톤. 그런데 무게 순위 꼴찌라고요?

why.img: a huge African elephant bull standing side view, big ribcage and heart inside

beats.img: a giant long slender whale seen from the side with small flippers, long spine and huge ribcage inside
beats.label: 갈비뼈

beats.say: 거대 세쿼이아 셔먼 나무는 줄기만 약 1,270톤이에요.
beats.img: a giant sequoia tree trunk cut horizontally in the middle, the upper section lifted and floating above the lower section, showing the large round cross-section full of growth rings
beats.label: 꽉 찬 나이테

beats.say: 줄기 47,000개 넘게, 뿌리는 하나. 판도는 약 5,900톤 한 그루예요.
beats.img: a thick block of soil sliced open like a cake, many thin white aspen trunks on top all growing from one single thick glowing root network underground
beats.label: 뿌리는 하나

verdict.say: 그런데 땅속 버섯 하나는 약 965헥타르, 무게를 잴 수도 없어요.
verdict.img: a wide block of forest soil sliced open like a cake, small round green trees on top, inside the soil a vast glowing white thread network spreading through the whole block
verdict.label: 버섯 균사

caption: 코끼리 10.9톤이 무게 순위 꼴찌라고? 🌲
